description: Defines the implementation of a Software Defined Radio (SDR) based Radio Unit, including configuration, dependencies, and class interface with methods for managing radio sessions, sectors, and notifiers.

classes.name: ru_sdr_impl
classes.description: Implements a SDR-based Radio Unit with methods for managing radio sessions, sectors, and notifiers.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns the metrics collector if metrics are enabled.

methods.name: get_rx_symbol_notifier
methods.description: Returns the lower PHY RX symbol notifier.

methods.name: get_timing_notifier
methods.description: Returns the lower PHY timing notifier.

methods.name: get_error_notifier
methods.description: Returns the lower PHY error notifier.

methods.name: set_radio
methods.description: Sets the radio session for this RU.

methods.name: get_baseband_gateway
methods.description: Returns the baseband gateway for a given sector.
